import ctypes,ctypes.util
lib=ctypes.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('lz4') or 'liblz4.so.1')
lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int];lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.restype=ctypes.c_int
def run(s,target=100):
 out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(b'X'*target,target); r=lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(ctypes.create_string_buffer(s),out,len(s),target,target); return r,out.raw[:min(target,120)]
# seq1 literals 10, offset0 match4, seq2 literals 86? final
N=10
s=bytes([N<<4])+b'A'*N+b'\x00\x00' + bytes([0xf0,86-15])+b'B'*86
r,out=run(s,100); print(r,out[:20],out[96:100],len(s))
# after match, token for literals only maybe works?
# Now one seq: literals 10 + match len (100-10) offset0 token low? matchlen = low+4 + ext. Low=15, ext = 90-19=71
s=bytes([(10<<4)|15])+b'A'*10+b'\x00\x00'+bytes([71])
r,out=run(s,100); print('single',r,out[:20],out[90:100],len(s))
PY
